attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 9.5 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2, and node3 (standbys) on Ubuntu 16.04, with all replication traffic carried over TLS and client-certificate authentication enforced against a cluster-dedicated CA. Verified end-to-end data replication, verified rejection of non-CA and non-SSL replication attempts, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol on all three nodes with proof of changed boot identity and post-restart health.
